notes: The stacking is the simulation and the climb is only the win condition, so Simulation leads and Obby & Platformer is named second rather than allowed to lead. That distinction is the whole routing decision here: letting the climb lead would import Obby's genre-wide P6, and there is nothing for P6 to validate because the staircase is player-built out of crates rather than an authored, physics-legal platform chain. The author settled the shape by asking for side-by-side independent stacks, which is plot-isolated, so Sandbox is the preset on its own shape, with collectible-nodes bent to the milk crates that are the material of the loop and social-hub dropped since a bare concrete warehouse has no storefront or upgrades. I added physics-rig because a stack that can collapse under you is a breakable assembly whose reaction is the entertainment, and I treated the warehouse as enclosing set dressing rather than an interior transition, so nothing pushes this off P0.
